summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust, through three indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, entered into three Membership Interest Purchase Agreements to acquire 100% of three data center property-owning entities for aggregate purchase prices of approximately $860.6 million, $1.1 billion, and $2.0 billion (GCDC 3), each subject to customary closing adjustments. The targets are 72 MW data centers in Gainesville, Virginia, fully leased to a hyperscale customer. Closings are expected in Q2 2026, Q1 2027, and Q1 2027 respectively, each independent. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for regulatory review and financing conditions.
